/**
 * Fuzz target for INSERT/SELECT consistency validation.
 *
 * This target generates fixtures, inserts them into MySQL,
 * and validates the data can be retrieved correctly.
 */
final class InsertSelectTarget
{
    private const ALL_TYPES_TABLE = <<<'SQL'
        CREATE TABLE all_types (
            id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
            col_tinyint TINYINT,
            col_tinyint_unsigned TINYINT UNSIGNED,
            col_smallint SMALLINT,
            col_mediumint MEDIUMINT,
            col_int INT,
            col_bigint BIGINT,
            col_float FLOAT,
            col_double DOUBLE,
            col_decimal DECIMAL(10,2),
            col_bit BIT(8),
            col_char CHAR(10),
            col_varchar VARCHAR(255),
            col_tinytext TINYTEXT,
            col_text TEXT,
            col_enum ENUM('a','b','c'),
            col_set SET('x','y','z'),
            col_date DATE,
            col_time TIME,
            col_datetime DATETIME,
            col_timestamp TIMESTAMP NULL,
            col_year YEAR,
            col_json JSON
        )
        SQL;

    private Generator $faker;
    private FixtureProvider $fixtureProvider;

    /**
     * Initializes the collaborators and declared state for this object.
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PDO $pdo,
    ) {
        $this->faker = Factory::create();
        $this->fixtureProvider = new FixtureProvider($this->faker);

        $this->pdo->exec(str_replace('CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE', self::ALL_TYPES_TABLE));
    }

    /**
     * Fuzz target callable.
     *
     * @param string $input Raw fuzzer input (mutated bytes)
     * @throws Error On INSERT/SELECT mismatch
     * @throws JsonException When a round-tripped JSON value is malformed
     */
    public function __invoke(string $input): void
    {
        $seed = crc32(str_pad($input, 4, "\0"));
        $this->faker->seed($seed);

        $fixture = $this->fixtureProvider->fixture(self::ALL_TYPES_TABLE);

        $columns = array_keys($fixture);
        $placeholders = array_fill(0, count($columns), '?');

        $sql = sprintf(
            'INSERT INTO all_types (%s) VALUES (%s)',
            implode(', ', $columns),
            implode(', ', $placeholders)
        );

        $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
            foreach (array_values($fixture) as $index => $value) {
                $type = match (true) {
                    $value === null => PDO::PARAM_NULL,
                    is_int($value) => PDO::PARAM_INT,
                    is_bool($value) => PDO::PARAM_BOOL,
                    default => PDO::PARAM_STR,
                };
                $stmt->bindValue($index + 1, $value, $type);
            }
            $stmt->execute();

            $id = (int) $this->pdo->lastInsertId();

            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT * FROM all_types WHERE id = ?');
            $stmt->execute([$id]);
            $result = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (!is_array($result)) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Failed to retrieve inserted row\n" .
                    "Seed: $seed\n" .
                    "ID: $id"
                );
            }

            foreach ($fixture as $column => $expected) {
                $actual = $result[$column] ?? null;

                if ($column === 'col_bit' && is_string($actual) && strlen($actual) === 1) {
                    $actual = ord($actual);
                }
                if ($column === 'col_json' && is_string($expected) && is_string($actual)) {
                    $expected = json_decode($expected, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                    $actual = json_decode($actual, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                }
                if ($column === 'col_set' && is_string($expected) && is_string($actual)) {
                    $expected = explode(',', $expected);
                    $actual = explode(',', $actual);
                    sort($expected);
                    sort($actual);
                }
                $matches = match (true) {
                    $expected === null || $actual === null => $expected === $actual,
                    is_float($expected) && is_numeric($actual) => $expected === 0.0
                        ? abs((float) $actual) < 0.0001
                        : abs($expected - (float) $actual) / abs($expected) < 0.001,
                    is_int($expected) && is_numeric($actual) => $expected === (int) $actual,
                    is_bool($expected) && is_numeric($actual) => $expected === (bool) $actual,
                    default => $expected === $actual,
                };

                if (!$matches) {
                    throw new Error(
                        "Value mismatch\n" .
                        "Seed: $seed\n" .
                        "Column: $column\n" .
                        'Expected: ' . var_export($expected, true) . "\n" .
                        'Actual: ' . var_export($actual, true)
                    );
                }
            }

        } finally {
            $this->pdo->rollBack();
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Fuzz\Target;

use Error;
use SqlCatalog\Facade\Analyzer;

/**
 * Feeds arbitrary bytes to the analyzer as if they were a source file.
 *
 * The analyzer is pointed at whatever a repository happens to contain, so it has
 * to survive anything: a file that is not PHP, a file that is half PHP, a file
 * whose statements nest deeper than anyone would write. Nothing it is given may
 * make it throw; a file it cannot read is reported, not raised.
 */
final class AnalyzeTarget
{
    private readonly Analyzer $analyzer;

    /**
     * Builds the target over an analyzer with the built-in extensions.
     */
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->analyzer = new Analyzer();
    }

    /**
     * Analyzes the input and checks that the catalog it produced is coherent.
     *
     * @throws Error When the catalog contradicts itself
     */
    public function __invoke(string $input): void
    {
        $catalog = $this->analyzer->analyzeSource(['fuzz.php' => '<?php ' . $input]);

        foreach ($catalog as $entry) {
            if ($entry->id === '' || $entry->site->file !== 'fuzz.php') {
                throw new Error('Catalogued a statement without an identity; input=' . bin2hex($input));
            }
            if ($entry->isExact() && str_contains($entry->sql(), '{$}')) {
                throw new Error('A resolved statement still shows a gap; input=' . bin2hex($input));
            }
        }

        if ($catalog->count() > 0 && $catalog->problems() !== []) {
            throw new Error('Reported both statements and a parse failure; input=' . bin2hex($input));
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Fuzz\Target;

use Error;
use PDO;
use PDOException;

/**
 * Prepares generated SQL on the MySQL server under test and reports unexpected rejections.
 *
 * The statement goes through the server's own PREPARE, so PDO never interprets placeholders
 * in the generated text. A fuzz run has no schema, so the server errors the grammar cannot
 * avoid are listed below with the reason each one is tolerated. Every other rejection is a
 * finding: it surfaces as an Error for PHP-Fuzzer to record together with the input.
 */
final class MySqlSyntaxCheck
{
    /**
     * Server errors tolerated for any statement, keyed by MySQL error code.
     *
     * Each of them is raised after the statement was parsed, while the server resolves names
     * that a schema-less run cannot provide or checks semantics the grammar does not encode.
     *
     * @var array<int, string>
     */
    public const IGNORED_CODES = [
        1046 => 'ER_NO_DB_ERROR: no default database is selected during the run.',
        1049 => 'ER_BAD_DB_ERROR: database names are generated, none exists.',
        1051 => 'ER_BAD_TABLE_ERROR: table names are generated, none exists.',
        1054 => 'ER_BAD_FIELD_ERROR: column names are generated, none exists.',
        1060 => 'ER_DUP_FIELDNAME: generated column lists may repeat a name.',
        1066 => 'ER_NONUNIQ_TABLE: generated table references may repeat an alias.',
        1067 => 'ER_INVALID_DEFAULT: the default value is checked against the column type after parsing.',
        1096 => 'ER_NO_TABLES_USED: the analyzer needs a table where the grammar allows none.',
        1101 => 'ER_BLOB_CANT_HAVE_DEFAULT: default values are checked against the column type after parsing.',
        1109 => 'ER_UNKNOWN_TABLE: table names are generated, none exists.',
        1111 => 'ER_INVALID_GROUP_FUNC_USE: aggregate placement is checked during analysis.',
        1115 => 'ER_UNKNOWN_CHARACTER_SET: character set names are generated identifiers.',
        1128 => 'ER_FUNCTION_NOT_DEFINED: loadable function names are generated, none is installed.',
        1136 => 'ER_WRONG_VALUE_COUNT_ON_ROW: row width is checked against the column list after parsing.',
        1193 => 'ER_UNKNOWN_SYSTEM_VARIABLE: variable names are generated identifiers.',
        1235 => 'ER_NOT_SUPPORTED_YET: the grammar still lists syntax the server rejects after parsing.',
        1241 => 'ER_OPERAND_COLUMNS: row value width is checked during analysis.',
        1253 => 'ER_COLLATION_CHARSET_MISMATCH: generated collations and character sets are combined freely.',
        1267 => 'ER_CANT_AGGREGATE_2COLLATIONS: collation mixing is checked during analysis.',
        1273 => 'ER_UNKNOWN_COLLATION: collation names are generated identifiers.',
        1277 => 'ER_BAD_REPLICA_UNTIL_COND: START REPLICA UNTIL options are validated after parsing.',
        1286 => 'ER_UNKNOWN_STORAGE_ENGINE: engine names are generated identifiers.',
        1288 => 'ER_NON_UPDATABLE_TABLE: updatability is checked during analysis.',
        1294 => 'ER_INVALID_ON_UPDATE: ON UPDATE is checked against the column type after parsing.',
        1295 => 'ER_UNSUPPORTED_PS: the statement parsed but PREPARE refuses this statement kind.',
        1302 => 'ER_CONFLICTING_DECLARATIONS: conflicting column attributes are rejected after parsing.',
        1305 => 'ER_SP_DOES_NOT_EXIST: routine names are generated, none exists.',
        1308 => 'ER_SP_LILABEL_MISMATCH: routine labels are generated identifiers.',
        1310 => 'ER_SP_LABEL_MISMATCH: routine labels are generated identifiers.',
        1319 => 'ER_SP_COND_MISMATCH: condition names are generated identifiers.',
        1324 => 'ER_SP_CURSOR_MISMATCH: cursor names are generated identifiers.',
        1327 => 'ER_SP_UNDECLARED_VAR: routine variable names are generated identifiers.',
        1330 => 'ER_SP_DUP_PARAM: generated parameter lists may repeat a name.',
        1332 => 'ER_SP_DUP_COND: generated condition declarations may repeat a name.',
        1353 => 'ER_VIEW_WRONG_LIST: view column counts are checked after parsing.',
        1391 => 'ER_KEY_PART_0: key part lengths are checked after parsing.',
        1407 => 'ER_SP_BAD_SQLSTATE: SQLSTATE literals are generated strings.',
        1415 => 'ER_SP_NO_RETSET: result sets in routines are rejected during analysis.',
        1426 => 'ER_TOO_BIG_PRECISION: numeric precision is checked after parsing.',
        1470 => 'ER_WRONG_STRING_LENGTH: user and host names are generated strings.',
        1492 => 'ER_PARTITIONS_MUST_BE_DEFINED_ERROR: partition definitions are checked after parsing.',
        1525 => 'ER_WRONG_VALUE: literal values are checked against their context after parsing.',
        1527 => 'ER_WARN_OPTION_MORE_THAN_ONCE: repeated options are rejected after parsing.',
        1564 => 'ER_PARTITION_FUNCTION_IS_NOT_ALLOWED: partition expressions are checked after parsing.',
        1584 => 'ER_WRONG_PARAMETERS_TO_STORED_FCT: routine calls are resolved during analysis.',
        1585 => 'ER_NATIVE_FCT_NAME_COLLISION: generated routine names may collide with native functions.',
        1624 => 'ER_REPLICA_HEARTBEAT_VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE: replication options are validated after parsing.',
        1630 => 'ER_FUNC_INEXISTENT_NAME_COLLISION: function names are generated, none exists.',
        1641 => 'ER_DUP_SIGNAL_SET: generated SIGNAL items may repeat a name.',
        1690 => 'ER_DATA_OUT_OF_RANGE: literal ranges are checked after parsing.',
        1791 => 'ER_UNKNOWN_EXPLAIN_FORMAT: EXPLAIN format names are generated identifiers.',
        1800 => 'ER_UNKNOWN_ALTER_ALGORITHM: ALGORITHM names are generated identifiers.',
        1801 => 'ER_UNKNOWN_ALTER_LOCK: LOCK names are generated identifiers.',
        3102 => 'ER_GENERATED_COLUMN_FUNCTION_IS_NOT_ALLOWED: generated column expressions are checked after parsing.',
        3143 => 'ER_INVALID_JSON_PATH: JSON paths are generated strings.',
        3146 => 'ER_INVALID_TYPE_FOR_JSON: JSON arguments are checked during analysis.',
        3568 => 'ER_UNRESOLVED_TABLE_LOCK: locking clauses are resolved during analysis.',
        3569 => 'ER_DUPLICATE_TABLE_LOCK: locking clauses are resolved during analysis.',
        3573 => 'ER_CTE_RECURSIVE_REQUIRES_UNION: recursive CTE shape is checked after parsing.',
        3577 => 'ER_CTE_RECURSIVE_REQUIRES_SINGLE_REFERENCE: recursive CTE shape is checked after parsing.',
        3579 => 'ER_WINDOW_NO_SUCH_WINDOW: window names are generated identifiers.',
        3593 => 'ER_WINDOW_INVALID_WINDOW_FUNC_USE: window function placement is checked during analysis.',
        3652 => 'ER_INVALID_VCPU_ID: resource group values are checked after parsing.',
        3654 => 'ER_INVALID_THREAD_PRIORITY: resource group values are checked after parsing.',
        3708 => 'ER_RESOURCE_GROUP_MISSING_MANDATORY_ATTRIBUTE: resource group attributes are checked after parsing.',
        3709 => 'ER_RESOURCE_GROUP_MULTIPLE_ATTRIBUTE_DEFINITION: resource group attributes are checked after parsing.',
        3714 => 'ER_CANT_MODIFY_SRID_0: SRID values are checked after parsing.',
        3763 => 'ER_GENERATED_COLUMN_NAMED_FUNCTION_IS_NOT_ALLOWED: generated column expressions are checked after parsing.',
        3769 => 'ER_DEFAULT_VAL_GENERATED_FUNCTION_IS_NOT_ALLOWED: default expressions are checked after parsing.',
        3770 => 'ER_DEFAULT_VAL_GENERATED_NAMED_FUNCTION_IS_NOT_ALLOWED: default expressions are checked after parsing.',
        3772 => 'ER_DEFAULT_VAL_GENERATED_VARIABLES: default expressions are checked after parsing.',
        3980 => 'ER_INVALID_JSON_ATTRIBUTE: JSON attribute strings are generated text.',
        3995 => 'ER_CHARACTER_SET_MISMATCH: character set combinations are checked during analysis.',
        4032 => 'ER_INVALID_CAST: cast targets are checked during analysis.',
        4101 => 'ER_NATIVE_FCT_NAME_COLLISION_WITH_IF_NOT_EXISTS: generated routine names may collide with native functions.',
        6006 => 'ER_EXPLAIN_INTO_IMPLICIT_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED: EXPLAIN INTO options are checked after parsing.',
        6033 => 'ER_CANNOT_EXECUTE_IN_PRIMARY: the statement parsed but this server role refuses it.',
        6037 => 'ER_SUPPORTED_ONLY_WITH_HYPERGRAPH: the statement parsed but needs the hypergraph optimizer.',
    ];

    /**
     * Server errors tolerated only with a specific message, as [code, message pattern, reason].
     *
     * These codes also cover rejections the grammar must not produce, so the message decides.
     *
     * @var list<array{int, string, string}>
     */
    public const IGNORED_MESSAGES = [
        [1064, '/ near \'PARSE_TREE /', 'ER_PARSE_ERROR on SHOW PARSE_TREE: only debug builds compile that statement.'],
        [1064, '/^(?:Constant, random or timezone-dependent expressions in \(sub\)partitioning function are not allowed|Wrong number of subpartitions defined, mismatch with previous setting) near /', 'ER_PARSE_ERROR raised by partition analysis after the statement parsed.'],
        [1210, '/^Incorrect arguments to (?:>>|<<|&|\||\^|<|<=|>|>=|like|DIV|%|\+|-|\*|\/)$/', 'ER_WRONG_ARGUMENTS: operator arguments are checked during analysis.'],
        [1221, '/^Incorrect usage of (?:spatial\/fulltext\/hash index and explicit index order|SRID and non-geometry column)$/', 'ER_WRONG_USAGE: index and column attribute combinations are checked after parsing.'],
        [1351, '/^View\'s SELECT contains a variable or parameter$/', 'ER_VIEW_SELECT_VARIABLE: view bodies are checked after parsing.'],
        [1367, '/^Illegal non geometric \'.*\' value found during parsing$/', 'ER_ILLEGAL_VALUE_FOR_TYPE: geometry literals are generated strings.'],
        [3580, '/^There is a circularity in the window dependency graph\.$/', 'ER_WINDOW_CIRCULARITY_IN_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH: window references are resolved during analysis.'],
        [3581, '/^A window which depends on another cannot define partitioning\.$/', 'ER_WINDOW_NO_CHILD_PARTITIONING: window references are resolved during analysis.'],
        [3587, '/^Window \'.*\' with RANGE N PRECEDING\/FOLLOWING frame requires exactly one ORDER BY expression, of numeric or temporal type$/', 'ER_WINDOW_RANGE_FRAME_ORDER_TYPE: window frames are checked during analysis.'],
        [3591, '/^Window \'.*\' is defined twice\.$/', 'ER_WINDOW_DUPLICATE_NAME: generated window lists may repeat a name.'],
        [3998, '/^Cannot cast value to TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE\.$/', 'ER_INVALID_CAST_TO_TIMESTAMP: cast targets are checked during analysis.'],
    ];

    /**
     * Client errors that mean the server went away rather than that the statement was rejected.
     *
     * @var list<int>
     */
    public const CONNECTION_ERRORS = [1040, 2002, 2006, 2013];

    /**
     * @param PDO $pdo Connection to the MySQL instance under test
     * @param string $grammarVersion Grammar version that produced the statement, e.g. "mysql-8.4.7"
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PDO $pdo,
        private readonly string $grammarVersion,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Verifies that MySQL parses the generated statement.
     *
     * @param string $sql Statement produced by the grammar
     * @param string $input Fuzzer input that produced the statement, so a finding can be replayed
     *
     * @throws Error When MySQL rejects the statement for a reason the grammar should not produce
     */
    public function verify(string $sql, string $input): void
    {
        if ($sql === '') {
            throw new Error("Statement generation returned an empty string\nInput (hex): " . bin2hex($input));
        }
        try {
            $quoted = $this->pdo->quote($sql);
            if ($quoted === false) {
                fwrite(STDERR, "Cannot quote generated SQL for server PREPARE.\n");
                exit(2);
            }
            $this->pdo->exec('SET @sql_faker_input = ' . $quoted);
            $this->pdo->exec('PREPARE sql_faker_check FROM @sql_faker_input');
            $this->pdo->exec('DEALLOCATE PREPARE sql_faker_check');
        } catch (PDOException $rejection) {
            $info = $rejection->errorInfo ?? [];
            $code = $info[1] ?? 0;
            $code = is_int($code) ? $code : 0;
            $detail = $info[2] ?? '';
            $detail = is_string($detail) ? $detail : '';
            if (in_array($code, self::CONNECTION_ERRORS, true)) {
                fwrite(STDERR, "MySQL connection failed: {$rejection->getMessage()}\n");
                exit(2);
            }
            if (isset(self::IGNORED_CODES[$code])) {
                return;
            }
            foreach (self::IGNORED_MESSAGES as [$ignoredCode, $pattern, $reason]) {
                if ($code === $ignoredCode && preg_match($pattern, $detail) === 1) {
                    return;
                }
            }
            throw new Error(
                "Unexpected error in generated SQL\n" .
                "Grammar: {$this->grammarVersion}\n" .
                'Input (hex): ' . bin2hex($input) . "\n" .
                "SQL: $sql\n" .
                'SQLSTATE: ' . (is_scalar($info[0] ?? null) ? (string) $info[0] : 'unknown') . "\n" .
                "Error Code: $code\n" .
                "Error: {$rejection->getMessage()}",
                0,
                $rejection
            );
        }
    }
}

30	        image: container-registry.oracle.com/mysql/community-server:8.4.7
31	        env:

51	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
52	    timeout-minutes: 60
53	    steps:
54	      - name: Check out the repository
55	        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
56	        with:
57	          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
58	      - name: Set up PHP
59	        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
60	        with:
61	          php-version: '8.5'
62	          extensions: ctype, date, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
63	          coverage: pcov
64	          tools: infection:0.35.4
65	          ini-values: memory_limit=256M
66	      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
67	        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
68	      - name: Install package dependencies
69	        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
70	        with:
71	          working-directory: packages/sql-fixture
72	          dependency-versions: locked
73	          composer-options: --prefer-dist
74	          require-lock-file: true
75	      - name: Check installed platform requirements
76	        run: |
77	          composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
78	          infection --version
79	      - name: Mutation testing on the whole source tree
80	        run: >-
81	          php -d memory_limit=1G "$(command -v infection)"
82	          --configuration=infection.json5 --with-uncovered
83	          --threads=4
84	          --only-covering-test-cases
85	          --min-msi=0 --min-covered-msi=0 --no-progress
86	          --logger-github
87	      - name: Reject skipped whole-tree mutants
88	        run: |
89	          php -d memory_limit=1G -r '
90	            $report = json_decode(file_get_contents("build/infection/infection.json"), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
91	            if (($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] ?? null) !== 0) {
92	                fwrite(STDERR, "Infection skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
93	                exit(1);
94	            }
95	          '
96	      - name: Create or update the package MSI issue
97	        if: success()
98	        continue-on-error: true
99	        uses: actions/github-script@ed597411d8f924073f98dfc5c65a23a2325f34cd
100	        env:
101	          # Keep these alert thresholds aligned with this package's infection.json5.
102	          MIN_MSI: '80'
103	          MIN_COVERED_MSI: '80'
104	        with:
105	          script: |
106	            const fs = require('node:fs');
107	            const stats = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/sql-fixture/build/infection/infection.json', 'utf8')).stats;
108	            const minMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_MSI);
109	            const minCoveredMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_COVERED_MSI);
110	            for (const value of [stats.msi, stats.coveredCodeMsi, minMsi, minCoveredMsi]) {
111	              if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 100) {
112	                throw new Error('Infection must report valid MSI percentages and thresholds.');
113	              }
114	            }
115	            const belowThreshold = stats.msi < minMsi || stats.coveredCodeMsi < minCoveredMsi;
116	            const run = `${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
117	            const marker = '<!-- mutation-msi:sql-fixture -->';
118	            const title = '[sql-fixture] Mutation testing MSI below threshold';
119	            const body = [
120	              marker,
121	              'Daily mutation testing on `main` is below the required score for `sql-fixture`.',
122	              '',
123	              '| Metric | Actual | Required |',
124	              '| --- | ---: | ---: |',
125	              `| MSI | ${stats.msi}% | ${minMsi}% |`,
126	              `| Covered MSI | ${stats.coveredCodeMsi}% | ${minCoveredMsi}% |`,
127	              '',
128	              `Commit: ${context.sha}`,
129	              `Run and mutation reports: ${run}`,
130	              `Run attempt: ${process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}`,
131	              '',
132	              'MSI thresholds are reported here without failing the workflow.'
133	            ].join('\n');
134	            await core.summary
135	              .addHeading('Mutation testing: sql-fixture')
136	              .addRaw(`MSI: ${stats.msi}% (required: ${minMsi}%). Covered MSI: ${stats.coveredCodeMsi}% (required: ${minCoveredMsi}%).`)
137	              .write();
138	            if (!belowThreshold) return;
139	            const issues = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listForRepo, {
140	              ...context.repo, state: 'all', per_page: 100
141	            });
142	            const existing = issues.find(issue => !issue.pull_request && (
143	              issue.body?.includes(marker) || issue.title === title
144	            ));
145	            if (existing) {
146	              await github.rest.issues.update({ ...context.repo, issue_number: existing.number, body });
147	            } else {
148	              await github.rest.issues.create({ ...context.repo, title, body });
149	            }
150	      - name: Upload mutation reports
151	        if: always()
152	        continue-on-error: true
153	        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
154	        with:
155	          name: sql-fixture-infection
156	          path: packages/sql-fixture/build/infection/
157	          if-no-files-found: ignore

name: Mutation (sql-fixture)

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '22 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: mutation-sql-fixture
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
    working-directory: packages/sql-fixture

jobs:
  mutation:
    name: Mutation Testing
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    services:
      mysql:
        image: container-registry.oracle.com/mysql/community-server:8.4.7
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: REDACTED
          MYSQL_ROOT_HOST: '%'
          MYSQL_DATABASE: sql_fixture
        ports: ['3306:3306']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd="mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -pREDACTED"
          --health-interval=10s --health-timeout=5s --health-retries=12
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17.2
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: REDACTED
          POSTGRES_DB: sql_fixture
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd="pg_isready -U postgres -d sql_fixture"
          --health-interval=10s --health-timeout=5s --health-retries=12
    env:
      SQL_FIXTURE_MYSQL_DSN: mysql:host=127.0.0.1;port=3306;dbname=sql_fixture
      SQL_FIXTURE_PGSQL_DSN: pgsql:host=127.0.0.1;port=5432;dbname=sql_fixture
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: ctype, date, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: pcov
          tools: infection:0.35.4
          ini-values: memory_limit=256M
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install package dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/sql-fixture
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
          infection --version
      - name: Mutation testing on the whole source tree
        run: >-
          php -d memory_limit=1G "$(command -v infection)"
          --configuration=infection.json5 --with-uncovered
          --threads=4
          --only-covering-test-cases
          --min-msi=0 --min-covered-msi=0 --no-progress
          --logger-github
      - name: Reject skipped whole-tree mutants
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=1G -r '
            $report = json_decode(file_get_contents("build/infection/infection.json"), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if (($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] ?? null) !== 0) {
                fwrite(STDERR, "Infection skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                exit(1);
            }
          '
      - name: Create or update the package MSI issue
        if: success()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/github-script@ed597411d8f924073f98dfc5c65a23a2325f34cd
        env:
          # Keep these alert thresholds aligned with this package's infection.json5.
          MIN_MSI: '80'
          MIN_COVERED_MSI: '80'
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const stats = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/sql-fixture/build/infection/infection.json', 'utf8')).stats;
            const minMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_MSI);
            const minCoveredMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_COVERED_MSI);
            for (const value of [stats.msi, stats.coveredCodeMsi, minMsi, minCoveredMsi]) {
              if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 100) {
                throw new Error('Infection must report valid MSI percentages and thresholds.');
              }
            }
            const belowThreshold = stats.msi < minMsi || stats.coveredCodeMsi < minCoveredMsi;
            const run = `${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const marker = '<!-- mutation-msi:sql-fixture -->';
            const title = '[sql-fixture] Mutation testing MSI below threshold';
            const body = [
              marker,
              'Daily mutation testing on `main` is below the required score for `sql-fixture`.',
              '',
              '| Metric | Actual | Required |',
              '| --- | ---: | ---: |',
              `| MSI | ${stats.msi}% | ${minMsi}% |`,
              `| Covered MSI | ${stats.coveredCodeMsi}% | ${minCoveredMsi}% |`,
              '',
              `Commit: ${context.sha}`,
              `Run and mutation reports: ${run}`,
              `Run attempt: ${process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}`,
              '',
              'MSI thresholds are reported here without failing the workflow.'
            ].join('\n');
            await core.summary
              .addHeading('Mutation testing: sql-fixture')
              .addRaw(`MSI: ${stats.msi}% (required: ${minMsi}%). Covered MSI: ${stats.coveredCodeMsi}% (required: ${minCoveredMsi}%).`)
              .write();
            if (!belowThreshold) return;
            const issues = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listForRepo, {
              ...context.repo, state: 'all', per_page: 100
            });
            const existing = issues.find(issue => !issue.pull_request && (
              issue.body?.includes(marker) || issue.title === title
            ));
            if (existing) {
              await github.rest.issues.update({ ...context.repo, issue_number: existing.number, body });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.create({ ...context.repo, title, body });
            }
      - name: Upload mutation reports
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: sql-fixture-infection
          path: packages/sql-fixture/build/infection/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - stacked
  check_suite:

      - completed

    permissions:

      - uses: upsidr/merge-gatekeeper@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          # Mutation jobs may run for 60 minutes; allow their startup and queue time as well.
          timeout: 4200

name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'composer.json'
      - 'composer.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/docs-preview.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: package-docs-publish
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages

jobs:
  build:
    name: Generate documentation for all packages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: gd, mbstring, pcntl, mysqli, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite
          coverage: none
      - name: Install the root project's locked dependencies
        run: |
          composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
          composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress
          composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Generate documentation
        run: |
          repository="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY,,}"
          composer docgen -- --base-url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}"
      - name: Upload the documentation site
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: package-docs
          path: build/docs/
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish:
    needs: build
    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
    steps:
      - name: Download the complete documentation site
        uses: actions/download-artifact@634f93cb2916e3fdff6788551b99b062d0335ce0
        with:
          name: package-docs
          path: build/docs

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the site
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          rsync -a --checksum --delete --exclude '/.git/' --exclude '/pr/' --exclude '/CNAME' ../build/docs/ ./
          touch .nojekyll

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this documentation."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: generate from ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"

      - name: Build GitHub Pages and wait for publication
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          expected_sha="$(git -C .docs-branch rev-parse HEAD)"
          gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds" > /dev/null
          for attempt in {1..60}; do
            build="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds/latest")"
            if [ "$(jq -r .commit <<< "$build")" = "$expected_sha" ]; then
              case "$(jq -r .status <<< "$build")" in
                built) exit 0 ;;
                # Pages can replace a cancelled build for this same commit.
                errored) jq .error <<< "$build" >&2 ;;
              esac
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          echo 'Timed out waiting for GitHub Pages publication.' >&2
          exit 1

name: Split Monorepo

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*'

# Each run pushes the whole state of a package, so runs for the same ref must not
# overlap: a run for an older commit that pushes last would overwrite a newer one.
# Queued runs wait for the running one, and only the newest queued run is kept.
concurrency:
  group: split-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  split:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        package:
          - local_path: ztd-query-core
            split_repository: ztd-query-core
          - local_path: bison-parser
            split_repository: bison-parser
          - local_path: lemon-parser
            split_repository: lemon-parser
          - local_path: sql-faker
            split_repository: sql-faker
          - local_path: sql-fixture
            split_repository: sql-fixture
          - local_path: sql-parser
            split_repository: sql-parser
          - local_path: sql-formatter
            split_repository: sql-formatter
          - local_path: sql-semantics
            split_repository: sql-semantics
          - local_path: sql-semantics-mysql
            split_repository: sql-semantics-mysql
          - local_path: sql-semantics-postgres
            split_repository: sql-semantics-postgres
          - local_path: sql-semantics-sqlite
            split_repository: sql-semantics-sqlite
          - local_path: sql-catalog
            split_repository: sql-catalog
          - local_path: requirements
            split_repository: requirements
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysql
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysql
          - local_path: ztd-query-postgres
            split_repository: ztd-query-postgres
          - local_path: ztd-query-sqlite
            split_repository: ztd-query-sqlite
          - local_path: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-pdo-adapter
          - local_path: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter
            split_repository: ztd-query-mysqli-adapter

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine version constraint
        id: version
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: |
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/v}"
          MAJOR="${TAG%%.*}"
          MINOR="${TAG#*.}"
          MINOR="${MINOR%%.*}"
          echo "constraint=^${MAJOR}.${MINOR}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "tag=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # k-kinzal/container is not published. Copy its definitions into every package
      # that uses them, so the tests, fuzz targets and benchmarks of the split
      # repository still find the Container namespace and its dependencies.
      - name: Bundle the container definitions
        run: |
          DIR="packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}"

          if ! jq -e '."require-dev" | has("k-kinzal/container")' "$DIR/composer.json" > /dev/null; then
            exit 0
          fi

          cp -R packages/container/src "$DIR/container"
          printf '%-25sexport-ignore\n' '/container/' >> "$DIR/.gitattributes"

          jq --slurpfile container packages/container/composer.json '
            (.require // {}) as $require |
            del(."require-dev"."k-kinzal/container") |
            ."require-dev" as $requireDev |
            ."require-dev" += ($container[0].require | del(.php) | with_entries(
              select(.key as $name | ($require | has($name)) or ($requireDev | has($name)) | not)
            )) |
            ."autoload-dev"."psr-4"."Container\\" = "container/"
          ' "$DIR/composer.json" > "$DIR/composer.json.tmp" && mv "$DIR/composer.json.tmp" "$DIR/composer.json"

      - name: Transform composer.json
        run: |
          FILE="packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}/composer.json"
          CONSTRAINT="${{ steps.version.outputs.constraint }}"

          if [ -n "$CONSTRAINT" ]; then
            jq --arg v "$CONSTRAINT" '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end) |
              .require |= with_entries(
                if (.key | test("^k-kinzal/(ztd-query-(core|mysql|postgres|sqlite|pdo-adapter|mysqli-adapter)|sql-faker|sql-fixture|sql-catalog|bison-parser|lemon-parser|requirements|sql-parser|sql-formatter|sql-semantics(-mysql|-postgres|-sqlite)?)$")) and .value == "dev-main" then .value = $v else . end
              ) |
              ."require-dev" |= with_entries(
                if (.key | test("^k-kinzal/(ztd-query-(core|mysql|postgres|sqlite|pdo-adapter|mysqli-adapter)|sql-faker|sql-fixture|sql-catalog|bison-parser|lemon-parser|requirements|sql-parser|sql-formatter|sql-semantics(-mysql|-postgres|-sqlite)?)$")) and .value == "dev-main" then .value = $v else . end
              )
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          else
            jq '
              (if .repositories then .repositories |= [.[] | select(.type == "path" | not)] else . end) |
              (if .repositories == [] then del(.repositories) else . end) |
              (if ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" then
                ."autoload-dev"."psr-4" |= with_entries(
                  if (.value | type) == "array" then
                    .value |= [.[] | select(startswith("../") | not)] |
                    if (.value | length) == 1 then .value = .value[0] else . end
                  else . end
                )
              else . end)
            ' "$FILE" > "${FILE}.tmp" && mv "${FILE}.tmp" "$FILE"
          fi

      - name: Remove the monorepo development lock file
        run: rm "packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}/composer.lock"

      - uses: danharrin/monorepo-split-github-action@v2.3.0
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ACCESS_TOKEN }}
        with:
          package_directory: packages/${{ matrix.package.local_path }}
          repository_organization: k-kinzal
          repository_name: ${{ matrix.package.split_repository }}
          user_name: k-kinzal
          user_email: k-kinzal@users.noreply.github.com
          tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}

name: CI (container)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/container/**'
      - '.github/workflows/container.yml'
      - '!packages/**/README.md'
      - '!packages/**/docs/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
    working-directory: packages/container

jobs:
  format:
    name: Format
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/container
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check the formatting
        run: composer format:check

  MySqlContainer and PostgreSqlContainer as static definitions; each version
  only sets $IMAGE. Remove MySqlConfiguration and PostgreSqlConfiguration.

  DSN) to the instance after startup, so callers no longer build the

  loc-guard, tree-guard, Deptrac and Infection, the mutation workflow, and
  every CI job except the format check.

name: CI (ztd-query-pdo-adapter)
'on':
  push:
    branches:
    - main
  pull_request:
    paths:
    - packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter/**
    - packages/container/**
    - packages/sql-faker/**
    - packages/sql-fixture/**
    - packages/ztd-query-core/**
    - packages/ztd-query-mysql/**
    - packages/ztd-query-postgres/**
    - packages/ztd-query-sqlite/**
    - .github/workflows/ztd-query-pdo-adapter.yml
    - '!packages/**/README.md'
    - '!packages/**/docs/**'
  workflow_dispatch: null
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
    working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
jobs:
  test:
    name: Tests (PHP ${{ matrix.php }}, MySQL ${{ matrix.mysql }}, PostgreSQL 16, SQLite)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php:
        - '8.1'
        - '8.2'
        - '8.3'
        - '8.4'
        - '8.5'
        mysql:
        - 8.0.44
        - 8.4.7
    env:
      MYSQL_VERSION: ${{ matrix.mysql }}
    steps:
    - name: Check out the repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
      with:
        php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
        extensions: ctype, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite,
          phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
        coverage: none
        ini-values: memory_limit=512M
    - name: Validate Composer metadata
      run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
    - name: Install dependencies
      uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
      with:
        working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
        dependency-versions: locked
        require-lock-file: true
        composer-options: --prefer-dist
    - name: Check installed platform requirements
      if: matrix.php == '8.1' || matrix.php == '8.2' || matrix.php == '8.3'
      run: composer check-platform-reqs
    - name: Check library requirements outside the locked ParaTest PHP range
      if: matrix.php == '8.4' || matrix.php == '8.5'
      run: composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
    - name: Pull database images before timed tests
      run: |
        php <<'PHP'
        <?php
        require 'vendor/autoload.php';
        $mysql = getenv('MYSQL_VERSION') === '8.4.7' ? new Container\MySql84Container() : new Container\MySql80Container();
        foreach ([$mysql, new Container\PostgreSql16Container()] as $container) {
            passthru('docker pull ' . escapeshellarg($container->image()), $status);
            if ($status !== 0) {
                exit($status);
            }
        }
        PHP
    - name: Run PHPUnit and doctest with ParaTest
      run: composer test
  lint:
    name: Static checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
    - name: Check out the repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
      with:
        php-version: '8.3'
        extensions: ctype, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite,
          phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
        coverage: none
        ini-values: memory_limit=512M
    - name: Validate Composer metadata
      run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
    - name: Install dependencies
      uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
      with:
        working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
        dependency-versions: locked
        require-lock-file: true
        composer-options: --prefer-dist
    - name: Check installed platform requirements
      run: composer check-platform-reqs
    - name: Check PSR-4 paths and ambiguous classes
      run: composer autoload:check
    - name: Check formatting
      run: composer format:check
    - name: Check source metrics
      run: composer loc-guard
    - name: Run PHPStan and toolkit rules
      run: composer phpstan
    - name: Check PHP compatibility
      run: composer compat
    - name: Check source tree
      run: composer tree-guard
    - name: Check architecture boundaries
      run: composer deptrac
  bench:
    name: Benchmark execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
    - name: Check out the repository
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
      with:
        php-version: '8.3'
        extensions: ctype, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, pdo_sqlite,
          phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
        coverage: none
        ini-values: memory_limit=512M
    - name: Validate Composer metadata
      run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
    - name: Install dependencies
      uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
      with:
        working-directory: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter
        dependency-versions: locked
        require-lock-file: true
        composer-options: --prefer-dist
    - name: Check installed platform requirements
      run: composer check-platform-reqs
    - name: Run the benchmarks
      run: |
        mkdir -p build/phpbench
        composer run-script --timeout=1200 bench -- --dump-file=build/phpbench/results.xml | tee build/phpbench/report.txt
    - name: Upload benchmark measurements
      if: always()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
      with:
        name: ztd-query-pdo-adapter-phpbench
        path: packages/ztd-query-pdo-adapter/build/phpbench/

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
    working-directory: packages/requirements

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test (PHP ${{ matrix.php }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5']
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: curl, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter, zlib
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/requirements
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        if: matrix.php == '8.1' || matrix.php == '8.2' || matrix.php == '8.3'
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Check library requirements outside the locked ParaTest PHP range
        if: matrix.php == '8.4' || matrix.php == '8.5'
        run: composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev
      - name: Run the tests in parallel
        run: composer test

  examples:
    name: Examples
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: curl, dom, mbstring, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/requirements
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist --no-dev
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Run each example as its own project
        run: |
          for example in yaml markdown extensions; do
            (
              cd "examples/$example"
              php ../../bin/requirements lint
              php ../../bin/requirements format --check
              php ../../bin/requirements check
              php ../../bin/requirements coverage
            )
          done
      - name: Verify the linked test of the extensions example
        working-directory: packages/requirements/examples/extensions
        run: php ../../bin/requirements spec --strict

  requirements:
    name: Requirements
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: curl, dom, mbstring, pcntl, xml, xmlwriter
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/requirements
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Validate the EARS definitions
        run: |
          php bin/requirements lint
          php bin/requirements format --check
      - name: Check the published EARS source
        run: |
          php bin/requirements check
          php bin/requirements coverage
      - name: Verify the EARS specifications
        run: php bin/requirements spec --strict

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'
          extensions: curl, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, pdo, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter, zlib
          coverage: none
      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@65e4f84970763564f46a70b8a54b90d033b3bdda
        with:
          working-directory: packages/requirements
          dependency-versions: locked
          composer-options: --prefer-dist
          require-lock-file: true
      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: composer check-platform-reqs
      - name: Check PSR-4 paths and ambiguous classes
        run: composer autoload:check
      - name: Check the formatting
        run: composer format:check
      - name: Analyse with PHPStan
        run: composer phpstan
      - name: Check PHP compatibility
        run: composer compat
      - name: Check the source metrics
        run: composer loc-guard
      - name: Check the directory structure
        run: composer tree-guard
      - name: Check the architecture layers
        run: composer deptrac

# NOTE: You do not have permission to overwrite this file. Please ask a human operator to perform the changes for you.
paths:
  - '.'

exclude:
  - '.git'
  - 'build'
  - 'vendor'

rules:
  - path: '**'
    deny_dirs: ['scripts', 'Scripts']
  - path: 'src/**'
    forbid_empty: true
    allow: ['*.php']
    file_case: pascal
    dir_case: pascal
    max_files: 15
    max_dirs: 20
  - path: 'tests/Unit/**'
    forbid_empty: true
    allow: ['*Test.php']
    file_case: pascal
    dir_case: pascal
    max_files: 15
    max_dirs: 20

report:
  reporter: ai
  order_by:
    - path
    - rule

1	---
2	name: setup-toolkit-pbt
3	description: >-
4	  Set up property-based testing with Eris in a PHP project, including
5	  domain-specific generators, shrinkable properties, reproducible seeds, PHPUnit
6	  group isolation, dedicated Composer commands, and a separate GitHub Actions
7	  workflow. Use when structured inputs and invariants are a better fit than
8	  coverage-guided byte fuzzing.
9	---
10	
11	# Set Up Property-Based Testing with Eris
12	
13	Property-based testing (PBT) verifies a contract over many generated structured
14	values and shrinks a failure to a smaller counterexample. It is not a replacement
15	for examples, and an iteration loop around random Faker values is not PBT unless
16	the generator, property, shrinking, and reproduction behavior are intentional.
17	
18	## Inspect and Choose the Contract
19	
20	Read `composer.json`, PHP and PHPUnit constraints, every lock and PHPUnit
21	configuration, current unit/integration scripts, coverage metadata policy, source
22	contracts, and existing generators or random tests.
23	
24	Use PBT when the important claim can be expressed over structured values, for
25	example:
26	
27	- encode/decode or parse/render round trips;
28	- idempotence and canonicalization;
29	- algebraic behavior that the product actually promises;
30	- equivalence with a small reference model or alternate implementation;
31	- invariants before and after a command sequence; or
32	- boundary-rich validation where Eris can shrink to a useful value.
33	
34	Use `/setup-toolkit-fuzzing` instead when corpus mutation and code-coverage feedback
35	are needed to explore a parser, protocol, query grammar, file format, HTTP request
36	surface, or other high-dimensional byte-oriented input. Both may be used on one
37	component when they verify distinct contracts.
38	
39	Before writing the property, state:
40	
41	1. the exact system boundary;
42	2. the input domain and invalid subdomains;
43	3. the invariant or reference model;
44	4. documented normalization or nondeterminism that affects comparison;
45	5. state reset and side-effect isolation; and
46	6. the cost per evaluation and resulting iteration budget.
47	
48	Do not derive the oracle from the same implementation path being tested. A
49	round-trip whose encoder and decoder share the same faulty normalization may need
50	an independent semantic check as well.
51	
52	## Install a Compatible Eris Release
53	
54	Inspect Eris release metadata at application time. Select the newest stable release
55	compatible with the PHP runtime and PHPUnit generation that executes PBT. Current
56	Eris release lines have different PHP/PHPUnit support; do not copy this repository's
57	constraint or assume one release spans a legacy PHPUnit 9 leg and a modern PHPUnit
58	10+ leg.
59	
60	Test the target-derived constraint first:
61	
62	```bash
63	composer require --dev "giorgiosironi/eris:<target-derived-constraint>" --dry-run
64	composer why-not giorgiosironi/eris <newest-compatible-version>
65	```
66	
67	Run the confirmed requirement without `--dry-run`. For a real multi-runtime library,
68	verify every maintained lock. Use a minimal union only when Composer must select a
69	legacy Eris line on an older PHP/PHPUnit leg and a modern line elsewhere. In that
70	case, write property tests against APIs present in both resolved lines, or keep an
71	explicit version-specific PBT runner. Do not drop a supported PHP version or weaken
72	the PHPUnit constraint just to install Eris.
73	
74	## Design Generators for the Domain
75	
76	Start with Eris generators and compose them with maps, tuples, vectors, sets, and
77	dependent generation. Create a named custom generator when a domain type has
78	non-trivial validity rules. Generate valid structures directly instead of
79	generating arbitrary values and discarding most of them with `when()` or
80	`suchThat()`; excessive discards reduce useful evaluations and can violate Eris's
81	minimum evaluation ratio.
82	
83	Keep these values reachable where the contract allows them:
84	
85	- empty, singleton, minimum, maximum, and just-outside-boundary values;
86	- duplicate and reordered collections;
87	- Unicode, invalid encodings, reserved tokens, and escaped values;
88	- nullability and omitted versus explicit default fields; and
89	- sequences that revisit a state or repeat an operation.
90	
91	Preserve shrinking. Mapping a generated primitive into a domain value is useful
92	only when failures can still shrink toward a simpler valid value. Avoid opaque
93	Faker calls, time-dependent data, global randomness, or generators that throw away
94	the relationship between a value and its shrink path.
95	
96	For stateful properties, generate commands allowed by the current model state and
97	compare the model with the system after every command. Reset the system before each
98	generated sequence. Eris may re-evaluate the property during shrinking, so the
99	callback must be deterministic and safe to repeat.
100	
101	## Write an Actionable Property Test
102	
103	Modern Eris integrates through `Eris\TestTrait`. Use the generator API supplied by
104	the installed release. A cross-version shape is:
105	
106	```php
107	use Eris\Generators;
108	use Eris\TestTrait;
109	use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
110	use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
111	
112	/**
113	 * @group pbt
114	 */
115	#[Group('pbt')]
116	final class CodecPropertyTest extends TestCase
117	{
118	    use TestTrait;
119	
120	    public function testDecodeInvertsEncode(): void
121	    {
122	        $this
123	            ->limitTo(500)
124	            ->forAll(Generators::string())
125	            ->then(function (string $value): void {
126	                self::assertSame($value, Codec::decode(Codec::encode($value)));
127	            });
128	    }
129	}
130	```
131	
132	Adapt names, generator, property, and budget to the target. `limitTo()` is useful
133	for source compatibility across Eris lines. On a modern-only project, the
134	installed release's `ErisRepeat` attribute may express the same iteration limit.
135	Do not use an annotation or attribute that the resolved legacy line does not
136	provide.
137	
138	Use `#[Group('pbt')]` with modern PHPUnit. Use `@group pbt` with PHPUnit 9. A suite
139	that genuinely executes the same source under both generations needs both forms,
140	consistent with the project's existing cross-version metadata policy. Add the
141	required `#[CoversClass]`, `#[CoversFunction]`, `#[CoversNothing]`, and legacy
142	coverage tags when the strict PHPUnit configuration requires them.
143	
144	Failure messages must identify the property and any context not already printed by
145	Eris. Do not dump hundreds of generated cases. Eris prints an `ERIS_SEED` command
146	for reproduction and shrinks assertion failures; preserve that output in CI logs.
147	
148	## Set an Explicit Budget
149	
150	Eris defaults to 100 evaluations per `forAll()` call, but the right budget depends
151	on generator breadth and evaluation cost. Set an explicit repeat/limit so runtime
152	does not drift with framework defaults. Pure in-memory properties can normally
153	afford more evaluations than database, filesystem, or process properties. Measure
154	locally and leave CI headroom; also bound shrinking time when the installed Eris
155	release supports it and shrinking can invoke expensive side effects.
156	
157	Do not pin a permanent seed in the normal CI run. A fresh seed explores new values;
158	a failing run prints the seed needed to reproduce it. Pin `ERIS_SEED` only while
159	reproducing or verifying a known failure. If replay is inconsistent, fix leaked
160	state, time, locale, external data, or other nondeterminism rather than keeping a
161	single green seed forever.
162	
163	## Isolate PBT from Ordinary Tests
164	
165	PBT must have its own `pbt` group and Composer command. Exclude that group from
166	every ordinary test entry point, including version-specific PHPUnit scripts and
167	ParaTest. Add or merge scripts in the target project, for example:
168	
169	```json
170	{
171	    "scripts": {
172	        "test": "paratest --processes=auto --exclude-group=pbt",
173	        "test:unit": "phpunit --testsuite unit --exclude-group=pbt",
174	        "test:pbt": "@php -d memory_limit=512M vendor/bin/phpunit --group=pbt"
175	    }
176	}
177	```
178	
179	Preserve existing configuration paths, memory limits, test suites, and
180	version-specific wrappers. The invariant is:
181	
182	- normal commands contain `--exclude-group=pbt` and run zero PBT tests; and
183	- `test:pbt` contains `--group=pbt` and runs at least one PBT test.
184	
185	Do not put a global XML `<exclude><group>pbt</group></exclude>` into a configuration
186	also used by `test:pbt`; combined include/exclude selection can make the dedicated
187	command run zero tests. A separate `tests/Property/` directory or testsuite is
188	useful for ownership, but the group remains required because command and CI
189	isolation must not depend on a directory convention alone.
190	
191	Do not add PBT to `lint`, the normal test matrix step, or the ParaTest aggregate.
192	PBT runs independently so ordinary feedback stays fast and a property failure is a
193	distinct CI signal.
194	
195	## GitHub Actions
196	
197	Read `pbt.yml` from
198	`vendor/k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkit/skills/setup-toolkit-pbt/` and apply it as
199	`.github/workflows/pbt.yml`. Replace every `REPLACE_WITH_*` sentinel from the
200	target's PHP support, extensions, lock policy, working directory, default branch,
201	and measured PBT runtime.
202	
203	Run the PBT workflow on pull requests and pushes to the default branch so it is a
204	real quality gate, plus `workflow_dispatch` for seed replay. One selected PHP
205	runtime is normally enough because the job checks domain properties, while the
206	ordinary matrix checks runtime compatibility. Use a PBT matrix only when the
207	property itself covers version-dependent behavior or different dependency graphs
208	implement meaningfully different contracts.
209	
210	Keep the manual seed as an environment variable and validate it before execution.
211	An empty seed must leave Eris free to choose a new one. Pin actions to full commit
212	SHAs, grant only `contents: read`, and give the job a measured timeout. Add service
213	containers only for properties that genuinely require them, with fresh synthetic
214	state for every property evaluation or sequence.
215	
216	## Triage a Failure
217	
218	1. Copy the `ERIS_SEED=...` command printed by Eris and replay only the failing
219	   property with the same PHP, dependency lock, locale, and service versions.
220	2. Confirm the displayed shrunk value still violates the stated contract.
221	3. Decide whether the product, property, generator, normalization rule, or state
222	   reset is wrong.
223	4. Fix the cause. Do not filter the counterexample out or lower the evaluation
224	   count merely to make CI green.
225	5. Add the minimized counterexample as a deterministic example test when it
226	   documents a valuable boundary, while retaining the broader property.
227	6. Rerun with the failing seed and again without a seed to resume exploration.
228	
229	## Verification
230	
231	Run the exact commands the target and CI use:
232	
233	```bash
234	composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
235	composer test:unit
236	composer test:pbt
237	```
238	
239	Also verify:
240	
241	- the normal test command reports zero tests from the `pbt` group;
242	- `composer test:pbt` reports at least one property test and more than a token
243	  assertion count from generated evaluations;
244	- a disposable failing property prints a replayable `ERIS_SEED`, shrinks, and
245	  fails the dedicated command; remove the probe afterward;
246	- replaying that seed reproduces the same counterexample;
247	- the ordinary suite, dedicated PBT suite, and every maintained legacy/modern
248	  PHPUnit configuration remain valid;
249	- `git diff --check` passes and actionlint validates `.github/workflows/pbt.yml`;
250	  and
251	- no installed file retains a `REPLACE_WITH` sentinel.
252	
253	## References
254	
255	- [Eris repository](https://github.com/giorgiosironi/eris) — Current compatibility, `TestTrait`, generators, attributes, and examples.
256	- [Eris reproducibility](https://eris.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reproducibility.html) — `ERIS_SEED` failure replay.
257	- [Eris shrinking](https://eris.readthedocs.io/en/latest/shrinking.html) — Counterexample reduction.
258	- [Eris runtime limits](https://eris.readthedocs.io/en/latest/limits.html) — Iteration, duration, evaluation ratio, and generated-size limits.
259	- [PHPUnit test groups](https://docs.phpunit.de/en/13.0/textui.html#test-selection-options) — `--group` and `--exclude-group` selection.
260

SHAs, grant only `contents: read`, and give the job a measured timeout. Add service
containers only for properties that genuinely require them, with fresh synthetic
state for every property evaluation or sequence.

## Triage a Failure

1. Copy the `ERIS_SEED=...` command printed by Eris and replay only the failing
   property with the same PHP, dependency lock, locale, and service versions.
2. Confirm the displayed shrunk value still violates the stated contract.
3. Decide whether the product, property, generator, normalization rule, or state
   reset is wrong.
4. Fix the cause. Do not filter the counterexample out or lower the evaluation
   count merely to make CI green.
5. Add the minimized counterexample as a deterministic example test when it
   documents a valuable boundary, while retaining the broader property.
6. Rerun with the failing seed and again without a seed to resume exploration.

## Verification

Run the exact commands the target and CI use:

```bash
composer validate --strict --no-check-publish
composer test:unit
composer test:pbt
```

Also verify:

- the normal test command reports zero tests from the `pbt` group;
- `composer test:pbt` reports at least one property test and more than a token
  assertion count from generated evaluations;
- a disposable failing property prints a replayable `ERIS_SEED`, shrinks, and
  fails the dedicated command; remove the probe afterward;
- replaying that seed reproduces the same counterexample;
- the ordinary suite, dedicated PBT suite, and every maintained legacy/modern
  PHPUnit configuration remain valid;
- `git diff --check` passes and actionlint validates `.github/workflows/pbt.yml`;
  and
- no installed file retains a `REPLACE_WITH` sentinel.

## References

- [Eris repository](https://github.com/giorgiosironi/eris) — Current compatibility, `TestTrait`, generators, attributes, and examples.
- [Eris reproducibility](https://eris.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reproducibility.html) — `ERIS_SEED` failure replay.
- [Eris shrinking](https://eris.readthedocs.io/en/latest/shrinking.html) — Counterexample reduction.
- [Eris runtime limits](https://eris.readthedocs.io/en/latest/limits.html) — Iteration, duration, evaluation ratio, and generated-size limits.
- [PHPUnit test groups](https://docs.phpunit.de/en/13.0/textui.html#test-selection-options) — `--group` and `--exclude-group` selection.

   10%, confirm the baseline assertion exits non-zero, and remove the probe.
5. Confirm `build/phpbench/` and `phpbench.json` are ignored while
   `phpbench.json.dist` and benchmark sources are tracked.
6. Run `git diff --check` and validate the changed workflow with actionlint.
   For comparisons, capture both stdout and stderr from `phpbench --version`;
   PHPBench can print its version on stderr. Two empty strings do not establish
   matching tool versions.
7. Search installed files for `REPLACE_WITH`; a remaining sentinel is a failed
   setup.

name: Fuzz (ztd-query-postgres)

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      max_runs:
        description: Maximum inputs evaluated by each fuzz target after the seed corpus is replayed
        required: true
        default: '1000'
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

jobs:
  fuzz:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    name: Fuzz ${{ matrix.target.name }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target:
          - name: behavior
            script: fuzz/fuzz_behavior.php
            corpus: fuzz/corpus/behavior
            fixtures: '0'
            extensions: pdo, pdo_pgsql, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
          - name: fixtures
            script: fuzz/fuzz_behavior.php
            corpus: fuzz/corpus/fixtures
            fixtures: '1'
            extensions: pdo, pdo_pgsql, dom, filter, hash, iconv, json, libxml, mbstring, pcntl, pcre, phar, reflection, simplexml, spl, tokenizer, xml, xmlwriter
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/ztd-query-postgres
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: ${{ matrix.target.extensions }}
          coverage: none

This repository is a PHP implementation of Zero Table Dependency (ZTD). | [ztd-query-core](packages/ztd-query-core/) | Core library: session, shadow store, rewrite planning, and platform contracts |

| [ztd-query-postgres](packages/ztd-query-postgres/) | PostgreSQL platform: SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, schema reflection |
| [ztd-query-sqlite](packages/ztd-query-sqlite/) | SQLite platform: SQL parsing, classification, rewriting, schema reflection |

## Related Projects

- [k-kinzal/ztd-query-php-scenario](https://github.com/k-kinzal/ztd-query-php-scenario): AI-operated example and lightweight contract suite for ztd-query-php adapters.
